_comment: The projectSlug rule, as CASES rather than as prose — a cross-language contract fixture, the same pattern tunnelProtocol.fixtures.json uses. There are now TWO implementations of one rule: projectSlug (src/shared/lib/core/projectPaths.ts), which the UI creates projects with, and project_slug (crates/bsc-project/src/lib.rs), which `bsc project new` creates them with. They MUST agree: the slug is what contains a free-text project name to one fixed directory, and it is also the project's frozen identity, so a divergence would let the two paths create two different hubs for one name. Both sides read this file in their tests.

cases._why: empty and non-latin names fall back rather than producing an empty key, which would name the projects root itself
the 60-char cap — the containment that keeps a long injected name from becoming a long path
cases.name: xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

cases._why: path traversal cannot survive the rule — this is the containment property, pinned as a case
cases.name: ../../etc/passwd
